scripts.build: yarn clean && yarn workspaces foreach -tv run build
scripts.format: prettier --write . && yarn workspaces foreach -p exec sort-package-json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && yarn workspaces foreach -p exec sort-package-json --check
scripts.snapshot:data: docker compose run --rm directus node /directus/cli.js data snapshot /directus/data.yml directus_settings directus_translations
scripts.snapshot:schema: docker compose run --rm directus node /directus/cli.js schema snapshot /directus/snapshot.yml
